name: codex-game-atelier
description: Codex-native workflows backed by a deterministic CLI for supported Godot projects.

interface.shortDescription: Create, validate, test, and export supported Godot projects.
interface.longDescription: Godot workflows for verified Starter creation, explicit initialization, project inspection, recorded validation and tests, committed-run diagnostics, bounded cleanup previews, unsigned macOS technical builds and exports, and read-only release readiness checks. External release and raw log retention are not implemented.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Codex Game Atelier Starter project in a directory I choose, then initialize it.
Inspect this Godot project and report its Atelier readiness.
Validate this initialized project and show the structured result.
Run the fixed GDScript tests after confirming required authorization.
